subject: Next steps: Activate pay rails & remittance format confirmation

Cc: accounts-payments@paybetter.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: PayBetter banking details + remittance format question

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier today. Per our conversation, I'm attaching our signed W-9 and an export of our bank details for ACH/wire. We can accept either ACH or wire; our preferred remittance format for automated reconciliation is a CSV with the following columns: PO, Invoice#, InvoiceDate, RemitTo (email), Amount, Currency.

Files attached: PayBetter_W9.pdf, paybetter_bank_details.csv

Quick questions for your team before we finalize enrollment: 
- Do you need our ACH routing + account masked in a particular schema (e.g., last 4 only) for your vendor portal?
- If Redwood sends automated remittance emails, what From address and subject line will you use so we can white-list?

I've CC'd accounts-payments so they have the details on file. If it helps, we can also upload to your vendor portal — provide the link and I'll do that.

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Head of Finance Operations
PayBetter Inc.
elena@paybetter.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Elena — thanks for these. Confirmed receipt of the W-9 and bank CSV. A few items from our side: 

- Finance (cc'd Monica) will need a filled vendor enrollment PDF and the PO number before we can send the first payment. I've attached our Redwood_VENDOR_ENROLLMENT_FORM_filled.pdf — please confirm the signatory and return if any details differ.
- For ACH micro-deposit verification: our payments processor will initiate a micro-deposit (small amount < $0.50) within 2 business days. Can you confirm which account (from the CSV) we should target for that? Please reply with the account nickname (e.g., "Operating - Main") or the last 4 digits.
- For remittance emails: we currently send from payments@redwood.com with subject line: "Redwood Inference — Remittance for Invoice {Invoice#}". Is that OK to white-list? We can include the PO and Invoice# in the CSV columns you requested.

Next steps: 
1) Elena confirms target account for micro-deposit and signs enrollment form if any changes.
2) Monica issues PO PO-78921 once vendor is verified.

Thanks — I'll track this in PROC-1123.

-Markus

4) ACH verify: target account = Operating - Main (last 4: 8342) — please confirm.

I'll provision the PO after we have the confirmation above and the completed enrollment form if any changes were made. If you prefer, we can also create a temporary one-time payment while enrollment finishes.
